topics.title: Mortality and life expectancy
topics.description: How long people live, how long they live in good health, what people die from, and where.
subtopics: Life expectancy and healthy life expectancy
Place of death and end of life care

topics.title: Cancer
topics.description: New cancer cases, screening, diagnosis and deaths, by cancer site.

topics.title: Heart and kidney disease
topics.description: Heart conditions, high blood pressure and cholesterol, stroke and kidney disease (cardiovascular and renal conditions).

topics.title: Diabetes
topics.description: Diabetes prevalence and risk, care and treatment, and complications.

topics.title: Mental health and wellbeing
topics.description: Mental health conditions, wellbeing, self-harm and suicide, and mental health services.
subtopics: Children and young people's mental health
Physical health of people with mental illness

topics.title: Brain and neurological conditions
topics.description: Dementia, epilepsy and other conditions affecting the brain and nervous system.

topics.title: Breathing and respiratory disease
topics.description: Asthma, COPD, pneumonia and other conditions affecting breathing.

topics.title: Liver disease
topics.description: Liver disease, including disease linked to alcohol and fatty liver.

topics.title: Muscles, bones and joints
topics.description: Back pain, arthritis, osteoporosis and fractures (musculoskeletal conditions).

topics.title: Sight and hearing
topics.description: Sight loss, eye care and hearing (sensory health).

topics.title: Dental and oral health
topics.description: Tooth decay, oral health and dental services.

topics.title: Stopping the spread of infection
topics.description: How infections are prevented, detected and controlled, including vaccination, healthcare-associated infections and antibiotic resistance (health protection).

topics.title: Sexual and reproductive health
topics.description: Sexually transmitted infections, HIV, contraception, abortion and teenage pregnancy.

topics.title: Pregnancy and early years
topics.description: Pregnancy and birth, babies' health, infant feeding and early child development.
subtopics: Screening in pregnancy and for newborns
Early years development and health visiting

topics.title: Injuries
topics.description: Falls, road traffic injuries and injuries to children and young people.
subtopics: Injuries in children and young people

topics.title: Health behaviours
topics.description: Everyday behaviours that affect health, such as smoking, alcohol, drugs, diet, physical activity and weight.

topics.title: What shapes our health
topics.description: The wider conditions in people's lives, such as income, housing, education, work and the local environment (the wider determinants of health).

topics.title: Fairness in health and vulnerable groups
topics.description: Differences in health between areas and groups, and the health of groups at greater risk of poor health.
subtopics: Health inequalities between areas and communities
Groups facing additional barriers to good health
Disability, long-term conditions and mental health
Carers and people who use social care
Children in care and child protection
People in contact with the justice system

topics.title: Using health and care services
topics.description: How people use hospital, A&E, GP and social care services, and their experience of care.

values.name: Outcome
values.definition: A measure of health status, illness, disability or death, including the prevalence of a condition.
values.status: First pass generated from titles; needs SME check

values.name: Risk factor
values.definition: A behaviour or exposure that increases the risk of poor health, including the prevalence of that behaviour or exposure.

values.name: Wider determinant
values.definition: A social, economic or environmental condition that shapes health.

values.name: Intervention or service
values.definition: The delivery, uptake or quality of a treatment, service or programme, excluding screening.

values.name: Screening
values.definition: The coverage or uptake of a screening programme.

values.name: Inequality summary measure
values.definition: A gap, ratio, slope index or other measure comparing groups or areas. Always also placed in Health inequalities between areas and communities.

values.name: Data quality
values.definition: A measure of the completeness or quality of data recording.

values.name: Quality and Outcomes Framework
values.definition: Kept as a programme tag; 10 June research found users see QOF as a data source (open question).

values.name: National Child Measurement Programme
values.definition: Whether NCMP is a programme or a data source is an open question.

values.definition: Possible future label "Marmot places" under discussion with Peter Goldblatt.
